from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def fit(extra_fn, p0):
    def res(p):
        cols=[np.ones_like(P),P,P**2,1/P,np.log(P)]+extra_fn(p)
        X=np.column_stack(cols)
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
        return dP_dt-X@c
    s=least_squares(res,p0)
    r=res(s.x)
    return s.x, np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
